abstracts.abstract: A BILL TO AMEND THE SOUTH CAROLINA CODE OF LAWS BY AMENDING SECTION 59-104-20, RELATING TO THE PALMETTO FELLOWS SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM, SO AS TO ADD THE CLASSIC LEARNING TEST AS AN APPROVED ASSESSMENT FOR RECEIVING SCHOLARSHIPS; BY AMENDING SECTION 59-149-50, RELATING TO THE LIFE SCHOLARSHIP, SO AS TO AMEND THE QUALIFICATIONS FOR A LIFE SCHOLARSHIP TO INCLUDE ACT AND CLT SCORES; AND BY AMENDING SECTION 59-26-20, RELATING TO THE DUTIES OF THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION AND COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION, SO AS TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "TALENTED AND QUALIFIED RESIDENT" TO INCLUDE ACT AND CLT SCORES.

posted_text:
🎓 Education
SC S 1018 — SC Scholarships Now Score CLT Too

South Carolina’s Palmetto Fellows and LIFE Scholarships will now consider scores on the Classic Learning Test (CLT) alongside – or instead of – the SAT or ACT. To qualify for a Palmetto Fellows Scholarship, students can meet criteria based on a minimum CLT score of 1200 or an equivalent ACT score. Alternatively, they can meet criteria based on a minimum CLT score of 1400 or an equivalent ACT score. ...
